residualRisks: Windows has no SIGALRM: per-check timeouts are not enforced there.
integrate/limit/solve/expand and large matrix powers are bounded only by the per-check timeout; a direct safe_expr.parse() caller has no timeout.
lint_skill.py is heuristic; getattr/dynamic dispatch can evade the scan (N-6); safe_expr is the enforcement boundary.
Non-atomic PNG writes and partial text output on exit 2/3 can leave artifacts (N-8).

CI does not run the skill suite (N-1).
